New home

Just another milestone.

Mon May 13 2024

"Congratulations sir, the unit is now under your name."

After the bicycle race yesterday, I achieved another life milestone today.

"You're living the Singaporean dream," a friend told me, "Work in a bank, own a house, travel each year."

Well, hope these don't define who I am😌
